investigation.name: Demo · real case: Deripaska, En+ and Rusal (OFAC 2018)
investigation.question: How did Oleg Deripaska own and control En+, Rusal and their sister companies, and what changed when OFAC lifted sanctions on them?
investigation.description: A demo built from two public records: OFAC's Federal Register notice of the 6 April 2018 Russia designations, and Treasury's 19 December 2018 letter to Congress on lifting sanctions on En+, Rusal and EuroSibEnergo. Addresses are kept exactly as each entry spells them. Loaded to show the shared-address red flag (BO-032) and sanctions and PEP data on real records.
